===Siding with Ceril=== [[File:Hazeel Cult - Quest map.png|thumb|409x409px|Map Showing the Hazeel Cult Quest Legend:
1: Start quest, [[Ceril Carnillean]], 2: [[Clivet]], 3: [[Alomone]] (level 13), A: Quest Area (Area to travel, from begin to end). Green numbers indicate valve locations.]] {{Needed|Weapon, armour and food}} [[File:Butler Jones chathead.png|left|frameless]] If you've chosen to side with Ceril, talk to [[Clivet]] in the cave to learn about [[Hazeel]], an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. '''Refuse'''. Clivet will sail away on a raft, saying that you'll never be able to find him. Go back upstairs, find the [[sewer valve]]s, and turn them in the proper direction. {{Checklist| *'''Valve 1''' - This is right across the bridge south of the Carnilleans' house. Turn it '''right'''. *'''Valve 2''' - This is right behind Carnilleans' house. Turn it '''right'''. *'''Valve 3''' - This is north of the cave. Turn it '''left'''. *'''Valve 4''' - This is south of the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it '''right'''. *'''Valve 5''' - Go south-east of the fourth valve, past the monk. Turn it '''right'''. }} After you've turned all five, go back into the cave. Board the raft, then head to the southernmost room and talk to [[Alomone]]. He will let it slip that Ceril's butler is part of the cult, before attacking you. Kill him, then open the chest in the room to get the [[Carnillean armour]]. '''Note''': You can use the [[drop trick]] if you want your own armour. Board the raft again in order to return to the sewer entrance. Back at the Carnilleans' house, talk to [[Ceril Carnillean]], who will take the armour from you and give you 5 coins. After the player accuses the butler, he will refuse to believe you. '''You'll see a quest reward screen, but you haven't received the real reward yet!''' {{Listen|filename=Oh Dear!.ogg|align=right|title=Congratulations! Quest complete!|desc=Or not...}} [[File:Hazeel Cult partial completion reward scroll.png|frame|centre|The first (fake) "reward". Continue the next step to claim your real reward.]] Search the [[cupboard (Hazeel Cult)|cupboard]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} and you will find the Mark of Hazeel and a bottle of poison. Show these to Ceril. He will fire Butler Jones and give you the ''real'' quest reward.
